europe_now.title: Poland investigates potential foreign involvement in drone-plant fire
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities are investigating possible foreign intelligence involvement following a fire at a drone manufacturing facility. Officials are treating the incident with high security significance given ongoing regional tensions.

sources.headline: Poland suspects foreign involvement in drone-plant arson attack
Poland investigates potential “foreign intelligence” involvement in fire at drone plant

europe_now.title: Spain blames Israel and Russia for disinformation during Ceuta migration crisis
europe_now.summary: The Spanish prime minister has accused both Israel and Russia of orchestrating and spreading disinformation campaigns during the recent migration crisis in Ceuta. The allegations highlight growing concerns over foreign interference and stability in southern Europe.

sources.headline: Spain blames Israel, Russia for spreading disinformation during Ceuta crisis

top_stories.title: France and Sweden defense agreement
top_stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron successfully concluded a major defense acquisition deal in Sweden involving French frigates. The bilateral agreement strengthens strategic military cooperation between the two European nations.

sources.headline: Macron seals €4.3-bn French frigate deal in Sweden

top_stories.title: Iceland rejects EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: Icelandic voters have formally rejected proposals to resume membership negotiations with the European Union. The decision clarifies the island nation's stance on European integration following a national referendum.
